thought.text: The full documented `db:dev_seed` completes. Now let me verify the app via HTTP login.

reasoning_content:
The db:setup ran but the schema may need to load. Let's verify test db loads schema and verify admin login.

Now let me verify the admin login via HTTP, and that the app still serves. Let me restart server (dev server may have stale). Actually the server has been running. Let me verify login.

Also run the documented `bin/rspec` maybe on a subset to see if it works. But tests use stale factories too. The guide says run `bin/rspec`. Full test suite might be huge. Let me try running a small spec that doesn't depend on stale factories, but likely all fail. This is an installation task - key deliverable is app installed and running.

Let me verify login and homepage.

action.command:
cd /workspace; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "root: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/
# get sign-in page + csrf
curl -s -c /tmp/cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in -o /tmp/signin.html -w "signin: %{http_code}\n"
TOKEN=$(grep -oP 'name="authenticity_token" value="\K[^"]+' /tmp/signin.html | head -1)
echo "token: ${TOKEN:0:20}..."
curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -c /tmp/cj.txt -o /tmp/after.html -w "login POST: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" \
  -d "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" -d "user[login]=admin@consul.dev" -d "user[password]=Aa12345678" -d "user[remember_me]=0" \
  http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in
grep -o "data-current-user-id=\"[^\"]*\"" /tmp/after.html | head -1
curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/ -o /tmp/home.html -w "home: %{http_code}\n"
grep -o "data-current-user-id=\"[^\"]*\"" /tmp/home.html | head -1
